question: Which Article of the Constitution defines States and Union Territories?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 1** of the **Indian Constitution** defines the name and territory of India. It states that **"India, that is Bharat, shall be a Union of States."**
 
• It establishes the structure of India as a **"Union of States"**, ensuring the integrity and sovereignty of the nation.
 
• **States and Union Territories** are categorized under **Schedules 1 and 8** of the Constitution, with their respective names and territories mentioned here.
 
• **Article 1(2)** specifies the territories of India, which include:
 
 
• The territories of the states.
 
• The Union territories specified in the First Schedule.
 
• Any other territories that may be acquired.
 
 
 
• **Article 1(3)** affirms the inclusion of new territories into the Union of India through various means like acquisition, integration, or other legal processes.
 
• The classification of **States and Union Territories** is essential for administrative purposes and governance. *Hence, Article 1 defines this structure.*
 
• The **Union of States** is an integral feature of the Indian Constitution, emphasizing that the Indian Union is indestructible, while the states' boundaries can be reorganized under **Article 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Article 1:**

 
 
• **Article 1** plays a significant role in defining India as a union and its territories.
 
• The inclusion of territories enables India to accommodate newly acquired areas or make administrative changes when required.
 
 
 
• **Article 239:**
 
 
• **Article 239** deals with the **administration of Union Territories** by the President through an administrator appointed by him.
 
• It does not define the states or Union Territories but ensures their governance mechanism under the Union Government.
 
 
 
• **Article 240:**
 
 
• **Article 240** provides the President with the power to make regulations for certain Union Territories like **Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, Dadra and Nagar Haveli**, and others.
 
• It does not define the territories but grants legislative powers for governance.
 
 
 
• **Article 32:**
 
 
• **Article 32** is known as the **"Right to Constitutional Remedies."** It allows individuals to move to the Supreme Court for the enforcement of their fundamental rights.
 
• It does not have any direct connection to the definition of states and Union Territories.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Article 1:**

 
 
• It reflects the federal structure of the Indian political system, where power is divided between the Union and the states, but the Union remains indissoluble.
 
• Article 1 is crucial for defining India's territorial integrity and maintaining its sovereignty.
 
 
 
• **Schedules Related to States and Union Territories:**
 
 
• **First Schedule:** Lists all the states and Union Territories along with their territorial boundaries.
 
• **Seventh Schedule:** Defines the division of powers between the Union and the States through three lists – Union List, State List, and Concurrent List.
